title: Any Member can turn on and publish their own Spotlight (Spotlight split, step 1)

source.ref: Owner picks 2026-10-28: 1 A, 2 A, 7 A, 8 A

detail: Today `spotlight.enable` and `spotlight.view` are granted only to Crew+ (lib/core/capabilities.ts), so a free Member cannot turn on a Spotlight. Owner ruling 2026-10-28: the personal Spotlight is free for every Member; Crew's part is the look studio, per-link numbers and bigger caps. This row opens the capability; the free blocks (Events, Programs, Contributions, Tip), the meters and the Crew upsell are the following rows of the plan.
